text: Mission Viejo has been my home for more than 40 years. I grew up here, raised my family here, and care deeply about protecting the community we all cherish.

I believe City Hall should put Mission Viejo residents first. My priorities are keeping our neighborhoods safe, maintaining our roads, parks, and community facilities, supporting local businesses, protecting taxpayer dollars, preserving our quality of life, and defending local control when higher levels of government try to make local decisions for us.

My service in the United States Navy, my work as a Congressional Aide, and my experience on the Community Services Commission have prepared me to lead with integrity, practical judgment, and accountability. I understand that good government starts with listening to residents, solving problems, and following through on commitments.
I will be accessible, responsive, and committed to making decisions based on what is best for Mission Viejo and the families who call it home, not politics or special interests.
It would be an honor to earn your trust and your vote. Together, we can preserve the character of Mission Viejo while preparing our city for a strong future.

statement.disclaimer: Statements are volunteered by the candidates and have not been checked for accuracy by any official agency.
